title: email.rs special: Email/copy,import,parse
description:
Implement Email/copy, Email/import, and Email/parse in src/email.rs (same file as core).

## Methods to implement

### Email/copy (RFC 8621 §5.6)
- Copy emails from fromAccountId to the current account
- onSuccessDestroyOriginal: if true, destroy source emails after copy
- onSuccessUpdateOriginal: patch source emails (e.g. add \Deleted keyword)
- Returns: created map of old-id → new Email object

### Email/import (RFC 8621 §5.7)
- Import raw RFC 5322 email blobs already uploaded via JMAP blob upload
- Each import entry: blobId, mailboxIds, keywords, receivedAt
- Parse raw bytes to extract headers (subject, from, date, message-id, references)
- Assign threadId based on In-Reply-To/References matching
- Returns: created map of client-assigned id → Email object, or notCreated map for failures

### Email/parse (RFC 8621 §5.8)
- Parse a blob as if it were an email; return Email object WITHOUT storing it
- Used for parsing attached emails (message/rfc822 parts)
- Honor same properties/bodyProperties/fetchBodyValues flags as Email/get
- Returns the parsed Email or an error per blobId

## Key notes
- Email/import and Email/copy both call backend.import_email / backend.copy_email
- Email/parse calls backend.parse_email
- Thread assignment for import: same header-inspection logic as Email/set create

## Test vectors
- Upload blob → Email/import → Email/get returns parsed subject
- Email/copy to self (same account, different mailbox) → two copies exist
- Email/parse raw RFC 5322 bytes → returns Email with correct from/subject
